svg.text: USB data isolation and upstream admission
Electrical candidate 31f4c817 • Automatic SYS5 brief c86a8d3
Blue values open manufacturer documents. * Exact manufacturer or order code open.
Matching remote labels and rails join electrically. X is deliberate NC. Fit and powered use held.
U2 data and relocated native connector
Use J2 Rd on each Type-C CC pin. Keep the module native 27R series resistors.
U4 PIO data to host outlet
Qualify one effective 15k pull-down per host data line. Disable stock weak pulls for this profile.
Raw J2 voltage qualifies native data
Local U4 breaker PG qualifies PIO data
U2 authorization resets on actual disconnect
GP8 low independently denies B. A sensed J2 loss clears the latch even if GP8 stays high.
Only a fresh authorized GP8 rising edge can enable B. USB suspend/reset must release GP8 in firmware.
